fact: The driver was late attending the Thursday Press Conference
offence: Breach of Article B10.1.1.a of the FIA F1 Regulations and Articles 12.2.1.i and 12.2.1.p of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 11 (Sergio Perez), and the Team Representative. The driver conceded that he was 22 minutes late for the Press Conference, however he explained that this was caused by two circumstances beyond his control. The first related to an insurance issue which resulted in his flight to Doha being delayed such that he landed only one hour prior to the scheduled start time for the Conference. Normally this would have allowed him sufficient time to meet his commitment, however on approach to the circuit, he was held up by several road closures. The Stewards note that other parties were likewise held up on arrival at the circuit due to similar circumstances. The team advised that it had kept the FIA Media Delegate informed of the delay. Accordingly, although this is a breach of the regulations, in view of the circumstances, no penalty is applied.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 11 Media Commitment
